_comment: Copy this file to scripts/import.config.json and fill it in. For each product you want to sell, paste the CJ product id (pid) from the product's CJdropshipping URL. Optionally pin a specific variant with `vid`. Retail price = CJ cost x markup, unless you set `priceUsd` explicitly. Your marketing copy (name, desc, features, tag, rating) overrides CJ's raw data on the storefront.

products.name: Cloud Orthopedic Dog Bed
products.desc: Therapeutic CertiPUR-US® memory foam that cradles joints and pressure points — a true difference-maker for seniors and large breeds.

products.name: Calming Hemp Chews
products.desc: Vet-formulated soft chews with organic hemp, chamomile, and L-theanine to take the edge off stressful moments.
